title: Reject an unavailable public tool
userIntent: Call a tool name that is not registered and receive an explicit capability error.

intendedBehavior: The MCP surface rejects an unknown tool instead of dispatching a fallback.
behavioralInvariants: Tool availability is explicit and closed-world for the selected toolset.
regressionRisks: Unknown names are silently routed or produce an unclassifiable transport failure.

provenance.note: Shared capability failure behavior anchored to the exact v1.7.2 release.
